findings: Initial S II2011,duo for soprano voice and saxophone,nine minutes,commissioned Maki Ota and Naomi Shirai. Composer sound page specifically identifies alto saxophone.

Premiere dates conflict: Zen-On work entry and printed catalog give3July2011,Subaru Hall Osaka;IRCAM gives30July2011 at same venue. A contemporary blog announces30JulyTokyo recital as commission premiere. Retain discrepancy pending performer/score verification.
Zen-On entry recording reference ODRCD359 appears misplaced. That album is Masanori Oishi solo saxophone Smoke with Initial S,not the voice/saxophone Initial S II. Do not link the album to this duo.
Composer sound page lists exact Initial S I and Initial S II performance with Maki Ota soprano/Naomi Shirai alto at Parthenon Tama and embeds composer SoundCloud playlist.
Score currently available by inquiry via Zen-On; no direct public preview or sale found.
